items.title: How Rakbank built centralized observability at scale with Amazon OpenSearch Service
items.summary: Rakbank re-platformed logging for its retail digital banking workloads on a cross-account, Multi-AZ Amazon OpenSearch Service design that ingests ~150 GB/day through Fluent Bit, using hot/UltraWarm/cold tiering and Amazon S3 archival for 7-year compliance retention and ~55% cost savings over an all-hot cluster.
items.creator: Georges Hamieh
